failure_resolution.three_daemon_fixed_harness_failure: Observed interrupted seed resume passed. A Python request helper parameter named operation collided with the exact JSON operation field. Renamed request_name and added a regression assertion before the successful full run.
failure_resolution.three_daemon_local_peer_link_failure: Three memberships converged, but the preexisting independent worker-to-worker link gate timed out before workspace scenarios. The later relay-free two-daemon supported run passed its narrower scenario.

harness_deadlines: 90 seconds per test wait or child command, inherited harness behavior; not daemon policy or an agent execution limit.
qualification_scope: Private production daemon processes, SQLite stores and ordinary directories on one macOS host. Not WAN, two-host, model-driven-agent or cross-platform qualification.
reproducibility_note: The supported two-daemon workflow is tracked in scripts/check_operations.py. The full three-daemon successful run used the same operations body before the additive workspace workflow option was added; the recorded harness fingerprints therefore differ. The final additive workspace workflow resource label was clarified to say unmeasured and its qualification label follows configured transport; successful behavior is unchanged. The final supported two-daemon campaign additionally removes Git from daemon and CLI child PATH and verifies its unavailability; earlier campaign outcomes and fingerprints remain separate.
resource_scope: Measured RSS samples only, not peak memory, CPU or network byte qualification; no performance thresholds.
